title: Foundry operator registry (.claude/foundry-operators.json)
description: The identity substrate the front-authorization floor resolves `operator_id` against. `foundry_authz.resolve_operator` treats membership of a key under `operators` as sufficient, so every key here is a valid authorizer -- which is why this schema requires each entry to carry the fields /foundry:init seeds, and why no Foundry verb writes this file.

operators.description: Map of operator_id -> operator record. The KEY is what resolve_operator matches.

propertyNames.description: Operator ids are plain slugs -- no path separators or JSON-Pointer escape characters.

added_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the operator was added.
